title: livingproof-world-result/0.2
description: Engine-neutral result of one engine loading one versioned world fixture. Every engine adapter emits this shape; a verifier joins two records on quantity name. Revision 0.2 supersedes the adapter-local 0.1 draft in livingproof-sim-mujoco.

status.description: PASS only if every quantity passes. UNSUPPORTED is never a pass.

feature.description: Required when status is UNSUPPORTED: the declared feature that could not be mapped.

content_version.description: Optional copy of fixture.content_version for UNSUPPORTED records.

adapter.description: The adapter that produced the record: semver version plus the full commit it was built from.

version.description: Semantic version, e.g. 1.2.0 or 1.1.0-dev.5+g696d9601e1a4. Never a bare commit.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit, or null when the adapter commit is unknown (for example no git checkout and no build provenance).

provenance.description: Optional: where version and commit came from: a git checkout or installed package metadata.

settings.description: Gravity/contact settings, drive method, sampling rate, measurement method and probe parameters.

name.description: Engine-neutral key from hallway-quantities.json, e.g. clear_width, place/spawn-exit/yaw, collision/open_end/+x/final_x. Names under reset/ are reserved for the reset checks.

comparison.description: within: pass when |measured - canonical| <= tolerance. at_most: pass when measured <= canonical + tolerance.

canonical.description: Canonical value or target from the fixture (for open_end/+x/final_x the target 2.80).
